steps.title: Unit 5 Test
steps.html:
Всё из трёх уроков этого юнита.

  • Урок 13: 5 a.m. club vs. night owls
  • Урок 14: Always? Sometimes? Never.
  • Урок 15: Who, what, when, where, why

steps.title: Прочитайте ещё раз. Дополните предложение.
steps.html:
Mira

Hi! I'm Mira. I get up at six o'clock.

I have breakfast and I check my emails.

I start work at eight and I finish at five.

My husband works at home. He gets up at nine!

steps.title: Расставьте слова по порядку.
steps.answer: We have dinner at half past seven.

steps.title: Найдите ошибку.
steps.answer: They go to bed at ten.

steps.title: Прочитайте ещё раз. Дополните предложение.
steps.html:
Olzhas

Hi! I'm Olzhas. I always get up at seven.

I usually go to work by bus. I don't drive.

I sometimes work at the weekend, but not often.

Do you work at the weekend? My sister never does.

steps.title: Найдите ошибку.
steps.answer: I never go to the gym.

steps.title: Послушайте. Выберите правильный ответ.
options: Pedro goes to work by bus.
Pedro doesn't go to work by bus.
steps.answer: Pedro doesn't go to work by bus.

steps.title: Прочитайте ещё раз. Выберите правильный ответ.
steps.html:
Lena

Hi! I'm Lena. I'm a guide in Almaty.

People ask me a lot of questions every day.

Where is the museum? When does it open? How much is a ticket?

My favourite question is: Why do you like your job? Because I meet people.

steps.title: Расставьте слова по порядку.
steps.answer: How many children have you got?

steps.title: Тест по юниту пройден
items: Урок 13: 5 a.m. club vs. night owls
